hooks.command: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'c:/dev/nexus/HANDOFF.md') { Write-Output '=== HANDOFF.md (top 50) ==='; Get-Content 'c:/dev/nexus/HANDOFF.md' -TotalCount 50 }; if (Test-Path 'c:/dev/nexus/ROADMAP.md') { Write-Output '=== ROADMAP.md (top 30) ==='; Get-Content 'c:/dev/nexus/ROADMAP.md' -TotalCount 30 }"

powershell -Command "Set-Location 'c:/dev/nexus'; $f=$false; if (Test-Path 'package.json') { npm run check 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $f=$true }; npm run typecheck 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $f=$true } }; if (Test-Path 'Cargo.toml') { cargo check 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $f=$true }; cargo clippy -- -D warnings 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $f=$true } }; if ($f) { Write-Output 'Quality checks failed. Fix issues before completing this task.'; exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"

npx @biomejs/biome check --write $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M HEAD | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$' | tr '
' ' ') 2>/dev/null || true
